features.name: Cloud Code
features.description: An AI development agent tool that behaves similarly to Copilot or other AI assistance tools, used for AL development.
caveats: Not the only AI tool available
Struggles with complex AL development without structured approach

features.name: Cloud Code plugins marketplace
features.description: A library of plugins that can be installed to package entire solutions, prompts and agents, with marketplace discovery capabilities.
caveats: Marketplace registration process may have changed
Installation process not clearly documented in all cases

features.name: Agent-based development workflow
features.description: A structured development process using multiple agents for planning, development, code review, diagnostics, documentation and testing with approval gates between phases.
caveats: Configuration provided as-is
Not all features tested or actively used by presenter
Interview command placement flexible

features.name: Planning agent with requirements and solution planning
features.description: First phase agent that creates requirements documents and solution documents with separate requirements engineer and solution planning sub-agents running with approval gates between them.
caveats: Initially had separate steps but presenter consolidated them
Requires manual approval to proceed

features.name: Develop agent with code review and diagnostics
features.description: Development phase agent that generates AL code, runs code review, and executes diagnostics with the compiler and code cups to identify and fix issues.
caveats: Cannot easily execute tests

features.name: Document-driven development approach
features.description: A workflow where all results are saved to markdown files in a folder structure, allowing sessions to be closed and resumed later while maintaining context clarity and enabling other agents to pick up from documentation.
caveats: Requires discipline in file organization

features.name: Agent-based orchestration for Cloud Code
features.description: Main session orchestrates multiple agents that read context from files, reducing the need for the main session to know all details and enabling longer coding sessions with distributed context.

features.name: AL Compile Wrapper Tool
features.description: Open source tool that simplifies AL compilation by automatically detecting VS Code extension folders, reusing the compiler, finding package caches and analyzers without requiring manual specification of complex compiler flags.
caveats: Requires being in a project directory

features.name: Requirements Engineer Agent
features.description: Agent that analyzes codebases to identify non-testable procedures and creates comprehensive refactoring plans to improve testability of existing code. Produces large requirements documents and authoring requirements from specifications.
caveats: Produces documents with some lingering questions requiring manual answers
Burned significant tokens for large document generation

features.name: Code Review Agent
features.description: Agent that reviews code to enforce development patterns like DRY and SOLID principles, treating warnings and infos as acceptable in diagnostics. Performs automated code review in separate sessions identifying non-blocking issues.
caveats: Still working on fully implementing DRY and SOLID patterns
Assumes warnings and infos in diagnostics are acceptable
Issues are categorized and require confirmation before developer agent applies fixes

features.name: Diagnostics Fixer Agent
features.description: Agent that automatically fixes diagnostic issues including lint interop warnings before code review, reducing manual cleanup work. Applies fixes for warnings and errors identified by the AL compiler.
caveats: Diagnostic rule configuration may need tweaking to catch all desired fixes
Currently catches main issues but leaves many info-level items

features.name: Interface wrapper pattern for testability
features.description: Design pattern using interface wrappers to mock dependencies in unit tests, avoiding single instance true when not needed and allowing code units to be assigned to interfaces.
caveats: Should avoid single instance pattern when possible

features.name: Iterative refactoring with context preservation
features.description: Workflow pattern where Cloud Code generates prompts and context files for the next planning iteration after exploring code, allowing clean context restart while preserving previous work in archive.

features.name: Solution planning agent
features.description: Agent that creates solution plans defining needed interfaces and procedures without writing full AL code. Produces approximately 700-line plans with architectural guidance.
caveats: Still includes some AL code despite instructions to avoid it
Instructions need refinement

features.name: Multi-phase developer agent
features.description: A developer agent that implements code in sequential phases, responding to mid-execution prompts for corrections and changes. Ran six phases with variable execution times and dynamically adjusted naming conventions based on live feedback.
caveats: Requires manual review and prompt corrections mid-execution
Access modifiers needed adjustment from local to internal for test app support

features.name: AL compiler JSON output
features.description: The AL compiler can output diagnostics directly to JSON format in a folder, making it easier for cloud code to process diagnostics without relying on command output.
caveats: Requires configuration in compiler settings
Currently produces many info-level items

features.name: Interface parameters with dependency injection
features.description: The developer agent successfully implemented interface parameters for internal procedures to enable dependency injection patterns, allowing refactored code to maintain testability.
caveats: Question remains whether very short local procedures with interface parameters should be tested

features.name: Unpolluted context with agent architecture
features.description: Agent-based development keeps context clean by having each agent start with only its specific instructions and relevant documents, preventing context pollution and sidetracking from previous iterations.
caveats: Each agent knows general documents and its specific instructions but not previous context

features.name: Cloud Profiles for AI Agent Configuration
features.description: Capability to take everything or use parts of cloud profiles including prompts and agents as needed.
caveats: Requires iterations

features.name: Agent Context Isolation
features.description: AI agents start with clean context containing only MCP server knowledge, general documents, and specific instructions, preventing distraction from prior conversation history.
caveats: Limited to specific agent scope

features.name: Agent File-Based Output Strategy
features.description: Agents write detailed findings to files and return only summaries to the main session, preventing context bloat and enabling longer development sessions without restart.
caveats: Requires manual file-based approach
Not automatic in all scenarios

features.name: Extended Agent Session Runtime
features.description: Ability to run uninterrupted AI agent sessions for over one hour with context staying at 69 percent utilization through strategic output management.
caveats: Depends on proper agent configuration and file output strategy

features.name: Agent-Driven Development Orchestration
features.description: Approach where developers orchestrate AI agents to write and refactor code rather than writing manually, focusing on reviewing and testing instead of typing.
caveats: Small bug fixes may still be faster to code manually
Requires careful review and testing
